title: Submit Alert Feedback
description:
Submit feedback for an alert by indicating like or dislike, rating the content and relevancy, as well as adding a comment.



> [!NOTE]
> For a successful submission:
> *   `alert_ID` and `like` parameters are mandatory.
> *   If you include `relevancy_rating`, you must also include `content_rating`, and vice versa.

body.name: like
body.description: Pass the value denoting your preference for the alert. Pass 0 for clearing previous feedback, 1 for like, and 2 for dislike.

body.name: alert_id
body.description: Pass the 8-digit unique alert ID for which you want to submit feedback. You can retrieve this using the **Get Alerts** endpoint.

body.name: comment
body.description: Pass the comment for the alert.

body.name: relevancy_rating
body.description: Pass your rating for the alert's relevancy using any value from 1 to 5, where 1 is the least relevant and 5 is the most relevant. If you pass this parameter, you must also pass `content_rating` in the request.

body.name: content_rating
body.description: Pass your rating for the alert's content using any value from 1 to 5. If you pass this parameter, you must also pass `relevancy_rating` in the request.

body.name: detail
body.description: Returns the status indicating whether the feedback was submitted successfully.

body.name: card_updated
body.description: Returns the 8-digit unique alert ID for which feedback is submitted.
